description: This file contains service functions for managing AI assistants, including creation, deletion, updating, importing, and retrieving assistants, as well as auxiliary functions for models, document stores, and tool management within a server-side application.

methods.name: createAssistant
methods.description: Creates a new assistant, either custom or based on external AI services, handling credential decryption, tool setup, and telemetry.

methods.name: deleteAssistant
methods.description: Deletes an assistant by ID, optionally removing associated external AI resources, with credential handling.

methods.name: getAssistantsCountByOrganization
methods.description: Counts assistants of a specific type within an organization.

methods.name: getAllAssistants
methods.description: Retrieves all assistants for a workspace, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getAllAssistantsCount
methods.description: Counts all assistants for a workspace, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: getAssistantById
methods.description: Fetches a specific assistant by ID within a workspace.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates assistant details, including external AI assistant configuration and local database record.

methods.name: importAssistants
methods.description: Bulk imports assistants, checking for duplicates and usage limits.

methods.name: getChatModels
methods.description: Retrieves available chat models excluding certain tags.

methods.name: getDocumentStores
methods.description: Fetches document stores with 'UPSERTED' status for a workspace.

methods.name: getTools
methods.description: Retrieves tools available for assistant integration, filtered by input parameter types.

methods.name: generateAssistantInstruction
methods.description: Generates instructions for an assistant based on a task and chat model, dynamically importing node modules.
